subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The cake had been baked by Sarah.

options.text: Sarah has been baking the cake.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice**. As per the question we have to change it into active voice.
 
• The given sentence is an example of** past perfect tense**.
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• *"Subject (objective case) + had been + past participle + by Object (subjective case*)" **(Passive voice)**
 
• *"Subject + had + past participle + Object"* **(Active voice)**
 
 
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• *The book had been read by her.* (Passive voice)
 
• *She had read the book.* (Active voice)
 
 
 
• **"Sarah"** will become the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The conjunction **"by"** will be removed.
 
• **"had been baked"** will be changed to **"had baked".**
 
• Following the above structure, we get the correct active voice: **"Sarah had baked the cake."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
